title: Владение техническими и ресурсными назначениями
goal: После защиты стандартных Django Admin форм сохранить поддерживаемые, доменно корректные пути изменения специальных источников доступа; резервный Admin-адаптер 00a ограничен контрактными ролями и флагами.
implementation_notes: apps.workorders owns Board.allowed_groups service, preview, authorization and domain audit model/event.
Settings Center view is a client of workorders service and does not define board policy.
Memory technical groups use a superuser-only apps.memory signed preview/apply service and domain audit; common user card remains read-only.
Settings Center expert view calls apps.memory service; seed/bootstrap commands create group definitions but do not replace membership audit.
Direct Django permissions remain system exception with no manual UI; document owner/source.
If a new manual technical-group or direct-permission requirement appears, stop for ADR instead of extending generic accounts UI.
acceptance_checks: Board.allowed_groups cannot change through Django Admin.
Authorized workorders service preview/apply changes board access and records audit.
Unknown/technical group not permitted by board policy is rejected.
Memory technical groups and direct permissions visible with source but not editable in common UI.
Expert memory-group membership preview/apply preserves contract roles and records domain audit.
No loss of supported operational board-access path.
independent_review: Domain-boundary and board visibility regression review.
